policies: Appointments are recommended; walk-ins are accommodated for urgent pain.
Please inform the front desk at least 24 hours in advance for rescheduling or cancellations. Missed or late-cancelled surgical slots incur a ₹300 fee.
Standard clinic tariffs apply to all patients. The front desk cannot offer or promise discounts.
Senior citizens (age 65+) receive a complimentary Digital X-Ray (RVG) with a paid consultation.
Accepted payment methods: UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm), Credit/Debit cards, and Cash.
All instruments follow Class-B autoclave sterilisation protocols.

insurance.summary: We provide itemised GST invoices, clinical summaries, and pre/post-treatment X-rays for OPD dental reimbursement claims. Direct cashless processing is not available at the clinic counter; patients file reimbursement with their insurer.

parkingAndAccess: Complimentary valet parking for cars and two-wheelers at the Road No. 12 entrance. Ground-floor clinic with step-free wheelchair access.
